displayPattern: 7-segment display on a *R9S96, *D9S96 or *R9S92 single-stage furnace in IOG-2037B (Goodman GR9S96, GD9S96 and GR9S92, and the Amana models in that same guide): EEH
meaning: Twin error. The twinning feature is not working. The chart says to check the wiring connections, then replace the integrated control board.
diySteps: Write down EEH. This code is about two furnaces twinned together, not a single-furnace heat call
Technician: check the twinning wiring connections
Technician: replace the integrated control board if the wiring does not clear EEH
safetyNote: If you smell gas, do not touch any electrical switch or use a phone in the building; leave immediately and call your gas supplier from outside. Turn off electrical power at the furnace switch or breaker before opening any panel, and never bypass or jumper a limit, rollout or pressure switch. Gas valve, burner, venting, wiring and control-board work should be done by a licensed HVAC technician.
proAdvice: Call a licensed HVAC technician. Twinning wiring and the control board are not a homeowner repair.
